title: AI Background Generator
summary: Free AI background generator: describe a place and get a film set, thumbnail, product backdrop, anime, game or video call background in any style.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI background generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every background on this page, costs 5 credits an image.


### How do I make a background with AI?


Describe the place, the time of day, the camera and the light, then say where the empty space should be and that no people should appear, and generate a few versions to compare before you keep one.


### Can AI change the background of a photo?


Yes. Add your photo and a background image as reference images, describe the subject exactly and ask for it on the new background with matching light, and the image model redraws the scene around your subject.


### What can I use AI backgrounds for?


AI backgrounds work as film and animation sets, YouTube thumbnail backdrops, product photo backdrops, video call backgrounds, game levels, slide and poster backgrounds, and plates for compositing characters into a scene.


### Can I make a background in a specific art style?


Yes. Name the style in the prompt, such as a hand-painted anime background, gouache, pixel art or cinematic film photography, or pick a Flickpedia style so every background in a project shares the same look.


### Can I turn a background into a moving video?


Yes. Use the background as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick, describe small motion such as drifting mist, rain or flickering lights, and keep the camera locked off so it loops calmly behind your subject.
